title: Dinosaur wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <polygon points='22,78 8,64 12,60 30,72' fill='#5bc85b'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='78' width='10' height='14' rx='3' fill='#3f9e3f'/>
  <rect x='56' y='78' width='10' height='14' rx='3' fill='#3f9e3f'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#7ee07e'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#7ee07e'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#5bc85b'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#c9f7a0'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='34' width='16' height='20' rx='7' fill='#5bc85b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#5bc85b'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='34' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#7ee07e'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='31' r='1.6' fill='#2f7a2f'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='33' r='1.6' fill='#2f7a2f'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M52 39 Q58 43 64 39' stroke='#2f7a2f' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='4.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='24' r='2.4' fill='#1f5f1f'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <polygon points='30,52 24,44 34,46' fill='#f7d94c'/>
  <polygon points='26,64 18,60 27,58' fill='#f7d94c'/>
  <!-- arm -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='62' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3f9e3f' transform='rotate(-20 70 62)'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='44,14 56,14 50,-2' fill='#f75c9e'/>
  <rect x='43' y='12' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='0' r='3' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='47,6 53,6 50,1' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
</svg>
